why: Consumer fixture snapshots must detect byte, executable-mode and inventory drift independently of the recorded provenance.

mutations.name: changed fixture bytes are ignored
mutations.breaks: A fixture may change its canonical content while retaining stale provenance.

mutations.name: executable-mode drift is ignored
mutations.breaks: An executable fixture can be accepted as identical to the recorded non-executable source.

mutations.name: unlisted fixture files are ignored
mutations.breaks: Fixture additions can silently evade the reviewed provenance inventory.
